title: Mama Tabitha
dek: A forest herbalist who calls for help gathering rare ingredients when ordinary remedies fail her husband.
body:
Tabitha lives with her husband Bogdan in a foliage-covered forest home reached by a supplied map. Though called Old Tabitha, she appears young and says she is seventy-four. Her home contains a bed for Bogdan and a station for preparing remedies.

28 September · asking for help

Bogdan is feverish, weak and unable to move normally. Tabitha describes his condition as a worse variant of Black Bile Fever. Pell examines him and recognizes serious symptoms; the scene does not establish the cause of other illnesses in Prima.

Tabitha requests three Crimson Nightshade flowers, a vial of Stonemourn sap, five Sunblood shavings, four Ashroot crops and a mound of Thistlebrush. She provides containers and directs the adventurers to an old graveyard roughly an hour west of her home. She warns them about Kazhinju and asks that they spare her if a fight occurs.

Lucien, Pell, Vylaris, Jangir and Clive recover the ingredients with Kazhinju’s eventual help. Tabitha welcomes those who return with payment and a meal. She also treats Pell after his accidental exposure to an anaesthetic in her home. The scene closes without independently showing Bogdan’s recovery.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.
